briefing.headline: Gameweek 11 deadline is Saturday 21 November at 11:00 UTC, and many managers are moving N. Jackson, Barry and Evanilson in while selling João Pedro and Gvardiol.

points.text: Most bought this week: N. Jackson, Evanilson, Barry and Van Hecke. Most sold: João Pedro, Gvardiol, Guéhi and Calvert-Lewin.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: João Pedro (31.3% owned) has a thigh injury with an unknown return date. Gvardiol, Virgil, Guéhi, Belloumi and Manzambi are each 75% to play.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Price rises are coming for Gabriel, Rice, Konsa, N. Jackson and Tavernier. Saka, Madjo, Cook, Brooks and Schade are falling.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Three players have four yellow cards and risk a suspension: check your squad before the deadline.
points.label: reported
